JSONGRAB.Copied: JSON Grab: link copied to clipboard.
JSONGRAB.Expired: Link expired. Share again for a fresh one.
JSONGRAB.LocalUrlWarning: This address looks local. Phones and outside devices may not reach it. Set the Base URL override in the module settings.
JSONGRAB.QrUnavailable: QR code could not be generated. The link below still works.
JSONGRAB.Settings.BaseUrl.Name: Base URL override
JSONGRAB.Settings.BaseUrl.Hint: Origin used in generated links, for example https://foundry.example.com with no trailing path. Leave blank to use the address your browser is connected with.
JSONGRAB.Settings.LinkLifetime.Name: Link lifetime (minutes)
JSONGRAB.Settings.LinkLifetime.Hint: Share links revoke themselves automatically after this many minutes. Sharing again within the window resets the clock. Links that outlive your session are cleaned up on the next world load.
JSONGRAB.Settings.ExportPermission.Name: Who can share documents
JSONGRAB.Settings.ExportPermission.Hint: Locked to Game Master in this version. Wider options arrive in a later release.
